verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a comprehensive REST API with OpenAPI spec, scoped access tokens, webhooks, and a CLI that covers deployments, domains, DNS, certs, env vars, and logs, giving strong programmatic parity with core platform actions. However, there is no explicit claim or independent verification that every UI feature (e.g., toolbar, bot protection config, comments, flags UI, CMS draft preview) has a 1:1 API/CLI equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or documentation mapping every UI feature to an API/CLI endpoint, and independent confirmation that advanced UI-only features are fully scriptable.
